840BOOL RegisterHallOfFame_Init(OverlayManager *man, int *state) {
841 Main_SetVBlankIntrCB(NULL, NULL);
842 HBlankInterruptDisable();
843 GfGfx_EngineASetPlanes(GX_PLANEMASK_NONE);
844 GfGfx_EngineBSetPlanes(0);
845 G2_BlendNone();
846 G2S_BlendNone();
847 GX_SetDispSelect(GX_DISP_SELECT_MAIN_SUB);
848 Heap_Create(HEAP_ID_3, HEAP_ID_REGISTER_HALL_OF_FAME, 0x50000);
849 RegisterHallOfFameData *data = (RegisterHallOfFameData *)OverlayManager_CreateAndGetData(man, sizeof(RegisterHallOfFameData), HEAP_ID_REGISTER_HALL_OF_FAME);
850 MI_CpuFill8(data, 0, sizeof(RegisterHallOfFameData));
851 data->args = OverlayManager_GetArgs(man);
852 data->msgData = NewMsgDataFromNarc(MSGDATA_LOAD_DIRECT, NARC_msgdata_msg, NARC_msg_msg_0180_bin, HEAP_ID_REGISTER_HALL_OF_FAME);
853 data->msgFormat = MessageFormat_New(HEAP_ID_REGISTER_HALL_OF_FAME);
854 data->strbuf1 = String_New(500, HEAP_ID_REGISTER_HALL_OF_FAME);
855 data->strbuf2 = String_New(500, HEAP_ID_REGISTER_HALL_OF_FAME);
856 data->narcA101 = NARC_New(NARC_a_1_0_1, HEAP_ID_REGISTER_HALL_OF_FAME);
857 data->narcA180 = NARC_New(NARC_a_1_8_0, HEAP_ID_REGISTER_HALL_OF_FAME);
858 RegisterHallOfFame_GetPartyDetails(data);
859 RegisterHallOfFame_SetGfxBanks();
860 RegisterHallOfFame_CreateBgConfig(data);
861 RegisterHallOfFame_CreateSpriteGfxHandlers(data);
862 Sound_SetSceneAndPlayBGM(8, SEQ_GS_E_DENDOUIRI, 1);
863 Sound_SetSceneAndPlayBGM(71, 0, 0);
864 LoadFontPal0(GF_PAL_LOCATION_MAIN_BG, (enum GFPalSlotOffset)0x1E0, HEAP_ID_REGISTER_HALL_OF_FAME);
865 data->currentScene = REGHOF_SCENE_INDIV_MONS_INIT;
866 return TRUE;
867}
868
869BOOL RegisterHallOfFame_Exit(OverlayManager *man, int *state) {
870 RegisterHallOfFameData *data = OverlayManager_GetData(man);
871 RegisterHallOfFame_DestroySpriteGfxHandlers(data);
872 RegisterHallOfFame_DestroyBgConfig(data);
873 NARC_Delete(data->narcA180);
874 NARC_Delete(data->narcA101);
875 String_Delete(data->strbuf1);
876 String_Delete(data->strbuf2);
877 MessageFormat_Delete(data->msgFormat);
878 DestroyMsgData(data->msgData);
879 OverlayManager_FreeData(man);
880 Heap_Destroy(HEAP_ID_REGISTER_HALL_OF_FAME);
881 return TRUE;
882}
883
884BOOL RegisterHallOfFame_Main(OverlayManager *man, int *state) {
885 RegisterHallOfFameData *data = OverlayManager_GetData(man);
886 data->currentScene = sSceneFuncs[data->currentScene](data);
887 if (data->currentScene == REGHOF_SCENE_MAX) {
888 return TRUE;
889 }
890 RegisterHallOfFame_PicAnimationsTick(data);
891 return FALSE;
892}
893
894static void RegisterHallOfFame_SetGfxBanks(void) {
895 GfGfx_SetBanks(&sGfxBanks);
896}
897
898static void VBlankTask_RegisterHallOfFame_IndividualMonsCongrats(SysTask *task, void *taskData) {
899 RegisterHallOfFameData *data = (RegisterHallOfFameData *)taskData;
900 if (data->subprocCallback != NULL && !data->subprocCallback(data)) {
901 data->subprocCallback = NULL;
902 }
903 DoScheduledBgGpuUpdates(data->bgConfig);
904 SpriteSystem_DrawSprites(data->spriteGfxHandler);
905 SpriteSystem_TransferOam();
906 OS_SetIrqCheckFlag(OS_IE_V_BLANK);
907}
908
909static void RegisterHallOfFame_ReplaceSpriteChar(const void *pSrc, u32 offset, u32 size) {
910 DC_FlushRange(pSrc, size);

1017static RegisterHallOfFameScene RegisterHallOfFame_IndivMonsMain(RegisterHallOfFameData *data) {
1018 switch (data->sceneSubstep) {
1019 case REGHOF_INDIV_SUBSCENE_RESET:
1020 RegisterHallOfFame_IndivMons_ResetBgAndSpritePos(data);
1021 ++data->sceneSubstep;
1022 break;
1023 case REGHOF_INDIV_SUBSCENE_SETUP:
1024 ++data->sceneSubstep;
1025 if ((data->curMonIndex & 1) == 0) {
1026 RegisterHallOfFame_SetupSubproc(data, RegisterHallOfFame_ShowMon_LeftSide, REGHOF_SCENE_INDIV_MONS_MAIN);
1027 } else {
1028 RegisterHallOfFame_SetupSubproc(data, RegisterHallOfFame_ShowMon_RightSide, REGHOF_SCENE_INDIV_MONS_MAIN);
1029 }
1030 break;
1031 case REGHOF_INDIV_SUBSCENE_PLAY:
1032 if (data->subprocCallback == NULL) {
1033 ++data->sceneSubstep;
1034 } else {
1035 if (data->requestUnsilhouetteBackpic == TRUE) {
1036 RegisterHallOfFame_CreateTask_IndivMonAnimAndCry(data, data->curMonIndex, REGHOF_PIC_INDIV_BACK, TRUE, 0);
1037 data->requestUnsilhouetteBackpic = FALSE;
1038 }
1039 if (data->requestUnsilhouetteFrontpic == TRUE) {
1040 RegisterHallOfFame_CreateTask_IndivMonAnimAndCry(data, data->curMonIndex, REGHOF_PIC_INDIV_FRONT, TRUE, 2);
1041 data->requestUnsilhouetteFrontpic = FALSE;
1042 }
1043 }
1044 break;
1045 case REGHOF_INDIV_SUBSCENE_INCREMENT:
1046 RegisterHallOfFame_IndivMonsScene_DeleteSprites(data);
1047 ++data->curMonIndex;
1048 if (data->numMons == data->curMonIndex) {
1049 ++data->sceneSubstep;
1050 } else {
1051 data->sceneSubstep = REGHOF_INDIV_SUBSCENE_RESET;
1052 }
1053 break;
1054 case REGHOF_INDIV_SUBSCENE_EXIT:
1055 return RegisterHallOfFame_FadeToBlack(data, REGHOF_SCENE_INDIV_MONS_EXIT);
1056 }
1057 return REGHOF_SCENE_INDIV_MONS_MAIN;
1058}

1079static RegisterHallOfFameScene RegisterHallOfFame_WholePartyMain(RegisterHallOfFameData *data) {
1080 switch (data->sceneSubstep) {
1081 case REGHOF_WHOLE_SUBSCENE_INIT:
1082 ++data->sceneSubstep;
1083 RegisterHallOfFame_SetupSubproc(data, RegisterHallOfFame_WholeMonsSceneSubproc, REGHOF_SCENE_WHOLE_PARTY_MAIN);
1084 break;
1085 case REGHOF_WHOLE_SUBSCENE_MAIN:
1086 if (data->subprocCallback == NULL) {
1087 ++data->sceneSubstep;
1088 }
1089 if (data->requestBeginSpotlightsAndConfetti == TRUE) {
1090 data->spotlightsTask = RegisterHallOfFame_CreateSpotlightController(data);
1091 RegisterHallOfFame_AddSpotlight(data->spotlightsTask, -2925, FX32_CONST(20));
1092 RegisterHallOfFame_AddSpotlight(data->spotlightsTask, -1757, FX32_CONST(60));
1093 RegisterHallOfFame_AddSpotlight(data->spotlightsTask, -586, FX32_CONST(40));
1094 RegisterHallOfFame_AddSpotlight(data->spotlightsTask, 586, FX32_CONST(140));
1095 RegisterHallOfFame_AddSpotlight(data->spotlightsTask, 1757, FX32_CONST(120));
1096 RegisterHallOfFame_AddSpotlight(data->spotlightsTask, 2925, FX32_CONST(160));
1097 data->confettiTask = RegisterHallOfFame_CreateConfettiTask(data);
1098 RegisterHallOfFame_StartConfetti(data->confettiTask);
1099 GfGfx_EngineATogglePlanes(GX_PLANEMASK_BG1, GF_PLANE_TOGGLE_ON);
1100 GfGfx_EngineATogglePlanes(GX_PLANEMASK_BG2, GF_PLANE_TOGGLE_ON);
1101 GfGfx_EngineATogglePlanes(GX_PLANEMASK_BG3, GF_PLANE_TOGGLE_ON);
1102 ManagedSprite_SetDrawFlag(data->monPics[REGHOF_PIC_WHOLE_PLAYER], TRUE);
1103 ManagedSprite_SetDrawFlag(data->monPics[REGHOF_PIC_WHOLE_PLAYER_SHADOW], TRUE);
1104 for (int i = 0; i < data->numMons; ++i) {
1105 RegisterHallOfFame_RestoreMonPicPalette(data, i, REGHOF_PIC_WHOLE_MON + i);
1106 ManagedSprite_SetAffineScale(data->monPics[REGHOF_PIC_WHOLE_MON + i], 1.0f, 1.0f);
1107 ManagedSprite_SetDrawFlag(data->monPics[REGHOF_PIC_WHOLE_MON_SHADOW + i], TRUE);
1108 ManagedSprite_SetOamMode(data->monPics[REGHOF_PIC_WHOLE_MON + i], GX_OAM_MODE_NORMAL);
1109 ManagedSprite_SetOamMode(data->monPics[REGHOF_PIC_WHOLE_MON_SHADOW + i], GX_OAM_MODE_XLU);
1110 }
1111 data->requestBeginSpotlightsAndConfetti = FALSE;
1112 }
1113 if (data->requestPlayFlashKanseiSfx == TRUE) {
1114 // simulate taking a photo
1115 RegisterHallOfFame_AfterFullParty_FadeFromWhite(data);
1116 PlaySE(SEQ_SE_GS_DENDOUIRI_FLASH);
1117 PlaySE(SEQ_SE_GS_DENDOUIRI_KANSEI);
1118 data->requestPlayFlashKanseiSfx = FALSE;
1119 }
1120 if (data->unk_13060_4 == TRUE) {
1121 RegisterHallOfFame_AfterFullParty_FadeToBlack(data);
1122 data->unk_13060_4 = FALSE;
1123 }
1124 break;
1125 case REGHOF_WHOLE_SUBSCENE_EXIT:
1126 data->sceneSubstep = REGHOF_WHOLEEXIT_SUBSCENE_INIT;
1127 return REGHOF_SCENE_WHOLE_PARTY_EXIT;
1128 }
1129
1130 return REGHOF_SCENE_WHOLE_PARTY_MAIN;
1131}
1132
1133static RegisterHallOfFameScene RegisterHallOfFame_WholePartyExit(RegisterHallOfFameData *data) {
1134 switch (data->sceneSubstep) {
1135 case REGHOF_WHOLEEXIT_SUBSCENE_INIT:
1136 SysTask_Destroy(data->vblankTask);
1137 RegisterHallOfFame_EndConfetti(data->confettiTask);
1138 RegisterHallOfFame_DestroySpotlightsTask(data->spotlightsTask);
1139 ++data->sceneSubstep;
1140 break;
1141 case REGHOF_WHOLEEXIT_SUBSCENE_MAIN:
1142 if (RegisterHallOfFame_AreAllSpotlightsFinished(data) == TRUE) {
1143 ++data->sceneSubstep;
1144 }
1145 break;
1146 case REGHOF_WHOLEEXIT_SUBSCENE_EXIT:
1147 RegisterHallOfFame_DeleteCamera(data);
1148 RegisterHallOfFame_AfterWholePartyView_UnloadSpriteRes(data);
1149 RegisterHallOfFame_WholePartyScene_DeleteWindows(data);
1150 RegisterHallOfFame_WholePartyScene_DeleteBgTilemapBuffers(data);
1151 return REGHOF_SCENE_MAX;
1152 }
1153
1154 return REGHOF_SCENE_WHOLE_PARTY_EXIT;
1155}

1157static void RegisterHallOfFame_MonSpritePosScaleAnimStep(ManagedSprite *unkImageStruct, const RegHOFSpritePosScaleAnimParam *param, u32 duration, u32 step) {
1158 if (step == 0) {
1159 ManagedSprite_SetPositionXY(unkImageStruct, param->xStart, param->yStart);
1160 ManagedSprite_SetAffineScale(unkImageStruct, param->scaleStart, param->scaleStart);
1161 } else if (step == duration) {
1162 ManagedSprite_SetPositionXY(unkImageStruct, param->xEnd, param->yEnd);
1163 ManagedSprite_SetAffineScale(unkImageStruct, param->scaleEnd, param->scaleEnd);
1164 } else {
1165 s16 dx = ((abs(param->xStart - param->xEnd) * 256) / duration * step) / 256;
1166 if (param->xStart > param->xEnd) {
1167 dx = param->xStart - dx;
1168 } else {
1169 dx = param->xStart + dx;
1170 }
1171 s16 dy = ((abs(param->yStart - param->yEnd) * 256) / duration * step) / 256;
1172 if (param->yStart > param->yEnd) {
1173 dy = param->yStart - dy;
1174 } else {
1175 dy = param->yStart + dy;
1176 }
1177 ManagedSprite_SetPositionXY(unkImageStruct, dx, dy);
1178
1179 f32 fpos = param->scaleStart + (param->scaleEnd - param->scaleStart) / (float)duration * (float)step;
1180 ManagedSprite_SetAffineScale(unkImageStruct, fpos, fpos);
1181 }
1182}

1343static void RegisterHallOfFame_IndivMonsScene_SetMon3dSpriteTex(RegisterHallOfFameData *data, RegisterHofMon *hofMon, int picIdx) {
1344 NNSG3dResTex *resTex;
1345 void *fileData;
1346 const void *texData;

1348 int spriteSquareDim = hofMon->followPokeParam[1] ? 8 : 4;
1349 u32 size = 32 * spriteSquareDim * spriteSquareDim;
1350 int fileno = RegisterHallOfFame_GetMmodelBySpeciesFormGender(hofMon->species, hofMon->form, hofMon->gender);
1351 fileData = AllocAndReadWholeNarcMemberByIdPair(NARC_data_mmodel_mmodel, fileno, HEAP_ID_REGISTER_HALL_OF_FAME);
1352 resTex = NNS_G3dGetTex(fileData);
1353 texData = NNS_G3dGetTexData(resTex);
1354 void *buffer = Heap_Alloc(HEAP_ID_REGISTER_HALL_OF_FAME, size);
1355 for (u8 i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
1356 sub_020145B4((const u8 *)texData + size * i, spriteSquareDim, 0, 0, spriteSquareDim, spriteSquareDim, buffer);
1357 RegisterHallOfFame_ReplaceSpriteChar(buffer, imageLoc + size * i, size);
1358 }
1359 Heap_Free(buffer);
1360
1361 u32 plttLoc = NNS_G2dGetImagePaletteLocation(Sprite_GetPaletteProxy(data->monPics[picIdx]->sprite), NNS_G2D_VRAM_TYPE_2DMAIN);
1362 const void *loadPos = NNS_G3dGetPlttData(resTex);
1363 if (MonIsShiny(hofMon->mon) == TRUE) {
1364 loadPos = (const u8 *)loadPos + 0x20;
1365 }
1366 RegisterHallOfFame_ReplaceSpritePltt(loadPos, plttLoc, 0x20);
1367 Heap_Free(fileData);

1431static void RegisterHallOfFame_IndivMonsScene_PrintMonDetailsOnWindow(RegisterHallOfFameData *data, u16 monIdx, int windowIdx) {
1432 Window *windows = &data->windows[windowIdx];
1433 RegisterHofMon *hofMon = &data->mons[monIdx];
1434 Pokemon *mon = hofMon->mon;
1435 BoxPokemon *boxmon = Mon_GetBoxMon(mon);
1436
1437 FillWindowPixelBuffer(&windows[0], 0);
1438 ReadMsgDataIntoString(data->msgData, msg_0180_00004, data->strbuf1);
1439 BufferBoxMonNickname(data->msgFormat, 0, boxmon);
1440 StringExpandPlaceholders(data->msgFormat, data->strbuf2, data->strbuf1);
1441 AddTextPrinterParameterizedWithColor(&windows[0], 0, data->strbuf2, 2, 0, TEXT_SPEED_NOTRANSFER, MAKE_TEXT_COLOR(15, 2, 0), NULL);
1442 CopyWindowPixelsToVram_TextMode(&windows[0]);
1443
1444 FillWindowPixelBuffer(&windows[1], 0);
1445 if (hofMon->gender == MON_GENDERLESS || !hofMon->printGender) {
1446 ReadMsgDataIntoString(data->msgData, msg_0180_00003, data->strbuf1);
1447 } else if (hofMon->gender == MON_MALE) {
1448 ReadMsgDataIntoString(data->msgData, msg_0180_00001, data->strbuf1);
1449 } else if (hofMon->gender == MON_FEMALE) {
1450 ReadMsgDataIntoString(data->msgData, msg_0180_00002, data->strbuf1);
1451 } else {
1452 ReadMsgDataIntoString(data->msgData, msg_0180_00003, data->strbuf1);
1453 }
1454 BufferBoxMonSpeciesName(data->msgFormat, 0, boxmon);
1455 StringExpandPlaceholders(data->msgFormat, data->strbuf2, data->strbuf1);
1456 AddTextPrinterParameterizedWithColor(&windows[1], 0, data->strbuf2, 2, 0, TEXT_SPEED_NOTRANSFER, MAKE_TEXT_COLOR(15, 2, 0), NULL);
1457
1458 ReadMsgDataIntoString(data->msgData, msg_0180_00005, data->strbuf1);
1459 BufferIntegerAsString(data->msgFormat, 0, hofMon->level, 3, PRINTING_MODE_LEFT_ALIGN, TRUE);
1460 StringExpandPlaceholders(data->msgFormat, data->strbuf2, data->strbuf1);
1461 AddTextPrinterParameterizedWithColor(&windows[1], 0, data->strbuf2, 2, 16, TEXT_SPEED_NOTRANSFER, MAKE_TEXT_COLOR(15, 2, 0), NULL);
1462 CopyWindowPixelsToVram_TextMode(&windows[1]);
1463
1464 FillWindowPixelBuffer(&windows[2], 0);
1465 ReadMsgDataIntoString(data->msgData, msg_0180_00006, data->strbuf1);
1466 BufferBoxMonOTName(data->msgFormat, 0, boxmon);
1467 StringExpandPlaceholders(data->msgFormat, data->strbuf2, data->strbuf1);
1468 AddTextPrinterParameterizedWithColor(&windows[2], 0, data->strbuf2, 2, 0, TEXT_SPEED_NOTRANSFER, MAKE_TEXT_COLOR(15, 2, 0), NULL);
1469
1470 switch (RegisterHallOfFame_GetMetLocationType(data, mon, data->args->profile)) {
1471 case REGHOF_METLOC_CAUGHT:
1472 ReadMsgDataIntoString(data->msgData, msg_0180_00007, data->strbuf1);
1473 BufferLandmarkName(data->msgFormat, 0, hofMon->metLocation);
1474 StringExpandPlaceholders(data->msgFormat, data->strbuf2, data->strbuf1);
1475 break;
1476 case REGHOF_METLOC_HATCHED:
1477 ReadMsgDataIntoString(data->msgData, msg_0180_00008, data->strbuf1);
1478 BufferLandmarkName(data->msgFormat, 0, hofMon->metLocation);
1479 StringExpandPlaceholders(data->msgFormat, data->strbuf2, data->strbuf1);
1480 break;
1481 case REGHOF_METLOC_TRADED:
1482 ReadMsgDataIntoString(data->msgData, msg_0180_00009, data->strbuf2);
1483 break;
1484 case REGHOF_METLOC_KANTO:
1485 ReadMsgDataIntoString(data->msgData, msg_0180_00010, data->strbuf2);
1486 break;
1487 case REGHOF_METLOC_HOENN:
1488 ReadMsgDataIntoString(data->msgData, msg_0180_00011, data->strbuf2);
1489 break;
1490 case REGHOF_METLOC_SINNOH:
1491 ReadMsgDataIntoString(data->msgData, msg_0180_00014, data->strbuf2);
1492 break;
1493 case REGHOF_METLOC_ORRE:
1494 ReadMsgDataIntoString(data->msgData, msg_0180_00012, data->strbuf2);
1495 break;
1496 case REGHOF_METLOC_FATEFUL:
1497 ReadMsgDataIntoString(data->msgData, msg_0180_00013, data->strbuf2);
1498 break;
1499 case REGHOF_METLOC_SHUCKIE:
1500 case REGHOF_METLOC_KENYA:
1501 ReadMsgDataIntoString(data->msgData, msg_0180_00015, data->strbuf1);
1502 BufferLandmarkName(data->msgFormat, 0, hofMon->metLocation);
1503 StringExpandPlaceholders(data->msgFormat, data->strbuf2, data->strbuf1);
1504 break;
1505 }
1506 AddTextPrinterParameterizedWithColor(&windows[2], 0, data->strbuf2, 2, 24, TEXT_SPEED_NOTRANSFER, MAKE_TEXT_COLOR(15, 2, 0), NULL);
1507 CopyWindowPixelsToVram_TextMode(&windows[2]);
1508}

1523static void RegisterHallOfFame_IndivMonsScene_CreateMonSprites(RegisterHallOfFameData *data, int monIdx) {

1525 RegisterHallOfFame_IndivMonsScene_LoadSpriteGfx(data);

1531 RegisterHallOfFame_IndivMonsScene_SetPicGfxAndPltt(data, hofMon, 0, REGHOF_PIC_INDIV_BACK);

1534 RegisterHallOfFame_StartPicAnimSeq(data, REGHOF_PIC_INDIV_OWSPRITE, 2);
1535 RegisterHallOfFame_StartPicAnimSeq(data, REGHOF_PIC_INDIV_OWSPRITE_SHADOW, 2);

1537 RegisterHallOfFame_SetSilhouettePalette(data, REGHOF_PIC_INDIV_FRONT_SHADOW, REGHOF_SILHOUETTE_PAL_BLACK);
1538 RegisterHallOfFame_SetSilhouettePalette(data, REGHOF_PIC_INDIV_BACK_SHADOW, REGHOF_SILHOUETTE_PAL_BLACK);
1539 RegisterHallOfFame_SetSilhouettePalette(data, REGHOF_PIC_INDIV_OWSPRITE_SHADOW, REGHOF_SILHOUETTE_PAL_BLACK);

1595static BOOL RegisterHallOfFame_ShowMon_LeftSide(RegisterHallOfFameData *data) {
1596 switch (data->subprocStage) {
1597 case REGHOF_INDIV_SUBPROC_FLY_IN_BACKPIC:
1598 if (data->subprocTimer == 10) {
1599 u8 yOffset = data->mons[data->curMonIndex].yOffset;
1600 ScheduleSetBgPosText(data->bgConfig, GF_BG_LYR_MAIN_1, BG_POS_OP_SET_X, -72);
1601 ScheduleSetBgPosText(data->bgConfig, GF_BG_LYR_MAIN_2, BG_POS_OP_SET_X, 72);
1602 ManagedSprite_SetPositionXY(data->monPics[REGHOF_PIC_INDIV_BACK], 48, yOffset + 152);
1603 ManagedSprite_SetPositionXY(data->monPics[REGHOF_PIC_INDIV_BACK_SHADOW], 46, yOffset + 152);
1604 data->subprocTimer = 0;
1605 ++data->subprocStage;
1606 } else {
1607 ScheduleSetBgPosText(data->bgConfig, GF_BG_LYR_MAIN_1, BG_POS_OP_SUB_X, 7);
1608 ScheduleSetBgPosText(data->bgConfig, GF_BG_LYR_MAIN_2, BG_POS_OP_ADD_X, 7);
1609 ManagedSprite_OffsetPositionXY(data->monPics[REGHOF_PIC_INDIV_BACK], -24, 0);
1610 ManagedSprite_OffsetPositionXY(data->monPics[REGHOF_PIC_INDIV_BACK_SHADOW], -25, 0);
1611 ++data->subprocTimer;
1612 }
1613 break;
1614 case REGHOF_INDIV_SUBPROC_BACKPIC_CRY:
1615 data->requestUnsilhouetteBackpic = TRUE;
1616 ++data->subprocStage;
1617 break;
1618 case REGHOF_INDIV_SUBPROC_HOLD_BACKPIC:
1619 if (data->subprocTimer == 50) {
1620 data->subprocTimer = 0;
1621 ++data->subprocStage;
1622 } else {
1623 ++data->subprocTimer;
1624 }
1625 break;
1626 case REGHOF_INDIV_SUBPROC_FLY_IN_OVERWORLD_SPRITE:
1627 if (data->subprocTimer == 6) {
1628 ManagedSprite_SetPositionXY(data->monPics[REGHOF_PIC_INDIV_OWSPRITE], 32, 40);
1629 ManagedSprite_SetPositionXY(data->monPics[REGHOF_PIC_INDIV_OWSPRITE_SHADOW], 31, 39);
1630 RegisterHallOfFame_IndivMonsScene_SetOverworldSpritePos(data, &data->mons[data->curMonIndex]);
1631 data->subprocTimer = 0;
1632 ++data->subprocStage;
1633 } else {
1634 ManagedSprite_OffsetPositionXY(data->monPics[REGHOF_PIC_INDIV_OWSPRITE], 19, 7);
1635 ManagedSprite_OffsetPositionXY(data->monPics[REGHOF_PIC_INDIV_OWSPRITE_SHADOW], 20, 7);
1636 ++data->subprocTimer;
1637 }
1638 break;
1639 case REGHOF_INDIV_SUBPROC_ANIM_OVERWORLD_SPRITE:
1640 if (data->mons[data->curMonIndex].species == SPECIES_KRABBY || data->mons[data->curMonIndex].species == SPECIES_KINGLER) {
1641 RegisterHallOfFame_StartPicAnimSeq(data, REGHOF_PIC_INDIV_OWSPRITE, 3);
1642 RegisterHallOfFame_StartPicAnimSeq(data, REGHOF_PIC_INDIV_OWSPRITE_SHADOW, 3);
1643 } else {
1644 RegisterHallOfFame_StartPicAnimSeq(data, REGHOF_PIC_INDIV_OWSPRITE, 1);
1645 RegisterHallOfFame_StartPicAnimSeq(data, REGHOF_PIC_INDIV_OWSPRITE_SHADOW, 1);
1646 }
1647 ++data->subprocStage;
1648 break;
1649 case REGHOF_INDIV_SUBPROC_HOLD_OVERWORLD_SPRITE:
1650 if (data->subprocTimer == 20) {
1651 data->subprocTimer = 0;
1652 ++data->subprocStage;
1653 } else {
1654 ++data->subprocTimer;
1655 }
1656 break;
1657 case REGHOF_INDIV_SUBPROC_SHOW_HEADER_WINDOW:
1658 ScheduleWindowCopyToVram(&data->windows[0]);
1659 ++data->subprocStage;
1660 break;
1661 case REGHOF_INDIV_SUBPROC_HOLD_HEADER_WINDOW:
1662 if (data->subprocTimer == 60) {
1663 ScheduleSetBgPosText(data->bgConfig, GF_BG_LYR_MAIN_2, BG_POS_OP_SET_X, -16);
1664 ScheduleSetBgPosText(data->bgConfig, GF_BG_LYR_MAIN_2, BG_POS_OP_SET_Y, 256);
1665 ManagedSprite_SetPriority(data->monPics[REGHOF_PIC_INDIV_BACK], 2);
1666 ManagedSprite_SetPriority(data->monPics[REGHOF_PIC_INDIV_BACK_SHADOW], 2);
1667 data->subprocTimer = 0;
1668 ++data->subprocStage;
1669 } else {
1670 ++data->subprocTimer;
1671 }
1672 break;
1673 case REGHOF_INDIV_SUBPROC_FLY_IN_FRONTPIC:
1674 if (data->subprocTimer == 8) {
1675 ScheduleSetBgPosText(data->bgConfig, GF_BG_LYR_MAIN_2, BG_POS_OP_SET_X, 112);
1676 ScheduleSetBgPosText(data->bgConfig, GF_BG_LYR_MAIN_2, BG_POS_OP_SET_Y, 192);
1677 ScheduleSetBgPosText(data->bgConfig, GF_BG_LYR_MAIN_3, BG_POS_OP_SET_Y, 256);
1678 ManagedSprite_SetPositionXY(data->monPics[REGHOF_PIC_INDIV_FRONT], 88, 88);
1679 ManagedSprite_SetPositionXY(data->monPics[REGHOF_PIC_INDIV_FRONT_SHADOW], 104, 72);
1680 data->subprocTimer = 0;
1681 ++data->subprocStage;
1682 } else {
1683 ScheduleSetBgPosText(data->bgConfig, GF_BG_LYR_MAIN_2, BG_POS_OP_ADD_X, 16);
1684 ScheduleSetBgPosText(data->bgConfig, GF_BG_LYR_MAIN_2, BG_POS_OP_SUB_Y, 8);
1685 ManagedSprite_OffsetPositionXY(data->monPics[REGHOF_PIC_INDIV_FRONT], -21, 16);
1686 ManagedSprite_OffsetPositionXY(data->monPics[REGHOF_PIC_INDIV_FRONT_SHADOW], -24, 19);
1687 ++data->subprocTimer;
1688 }
1689 break;
1690 case REGHOF_INDIV_SUBPROC_SILHOUETTE_BACKPIC_OVERWORLD_SPRITES:
1691 ScheduleWindowCopyToVram(&data->windows[1]);
1692 RegisterHallOfFame_SetSilhouettePalette(data, 2, REGHOF_SILHOUETTE_PAL_BLACK);
1693 RegisterHallOfFame_SetSilhouettePalette(data, 4, REGHOF_SILHOUETTE_PAL_BLACK);
1694 RegisterHallOfFame_SetSilhouettePalette(data, 3, REGHOF_SILHOUETTE_PAL_RED);
1695 RegisterHallOfFame_SetSilhouettePalette(data, 5, REGHOF_SILHOUETTE_PAL_RED);
1696 ++data->subprocStage;
1697 break;
1698 case REGHOF_INDIV_SUBPROC_HOLD_FRONTPIC:
1699 if (data->subprocTimer == 40) {
1700 data->subprocTimer = 0;
1701 ++data->subprocStage;
1702 } else {
1703 ++data->subprocTimer;
1704 }
1705 break;
1706 case REGHOF_INDIV_SUBPROC_PRINT_MON_SPECIES_LEVEL_GENDER_AND_CRY:
1707 ScheduleWindowCopyToVram(&data->windows[2]);
1708 data->requestUnsilhouetteFrontpic = TRUE;
1709 ++data->subprocStage;
1710 break;
1711 case REGHOF_INDIV_SUBPROC_HOLD_MON_SPECIES_LEVEL_GENDER:
1712 if (data->subprocTimer == 20) {
1713 data->subprocTimer = 0;
1714 ++data->subprocStage;
1715 } else {
1716 ++data->subprocTimer;
1717 }
1718 break;
1719 case REGHOF_INDIV_SUBPROC_PRINT_MON_CAUGHT_DETAIL:
1720 ScheduleWindowCopyToVram(&data->windows[3]);
1721 ++data->subprocStage;
1722 break;
1723 case REGHOF_INDIV_SUBPROC_HOLD_MON_CAUGHT_DETAIL:
1724 if (data->subprocTimer == 240) {
1725 ScheduleSetBgPosText(data->bgConfig, GF_BG_LYR_MAIN_2, BG_POS_OP_SET_X, 72);
1726 ScheduleSetBgPosText(data->bgConfig, GF_BG_LYR_MAIN_2, BG_POS_OP_SET_Y, 0);

1987static void RegisterHallOfFame_GetPartyDetails(RegisterHallOfFameData *data) {
1988 u32 i;
1989 PokepicTemplate sp40;
1990 UnkStruct_02014E30 sp20[2];
1991 ARRAY_ASSIGN(sp20, ov63_0221FC38);
1992 NARC *narc = NARC_New(NARC_a_1_8_0, HEAP_ID_REGISTER_HALL_OF_FAME);
1993 BOOL encry;
1994 Pokemon *pokemon;
1995 RegisterHofMon *hofMon;
1996
1997 for (i = 0; i < Party_GetCount(data->args->party); ++i) {
1998 pokemon = Party_GetMonByIndex(data->args->party, i);
1999 encry = AcquireMonLock(pokemon);
2000 if (!GetMonData(pokemon, MON_DATA_IS_EGG, NULL)) {
2001 hofMon = &data->mons[data->numMons];
2002 hofMon->mon = pokemon;
2003 hofMon->species = GetMonData(pokemon, MON_DATA_SPECIES, NULL);
2004 hofMon->personality = GetMonData(pokemon, MON_DATA_PERSONALITY, NULL);
2005 hofMon->form = GetMonData(pokemon, MON_DATA_FORM, NULL);
2006 hofMon->gender = GetMonData(pokemon, MON_DATA_GENDER, NULL);
2007 hofMon->yOffset = GetMonPicHeightBySpeciesGenderForm(hofMon->species, hofMon->gender, 0, hofMon->form, hofMon->personality) + 8;
2008 hofMon->metLocation = GetMonData(pokemon, MON_DATA_MET_LOCATION, NULL);
2009 hofMon->level = GetMonData(pokemon, MON_DATA_LEVEL, NULL);
2010 hofMon->partyIndex = i;
2011 if (hofMon->species == SPECIES_NIDORAN_F || hofMon->species == SPECIES_NIDORAN_M) {
2012 hofMon->printGender = FALSE;
2013 } else {
2014 hofMon->printGender = TRUE;
2015 }
2016 ReadWholeNarcMemberByIdPair(hofMon->followPokeParam, NARC_fielddata_tsurepoke_tp_param, SpeciesToOverworldModelIndexOffset(hofMon->species));
2017 GetPokemonSpriteCharAndPlttNarcIds(&sp40, pokemon, MON_PIC_FACING_FRONT);
2018 sub_02014510((NarcId)sp40.narcID, sp40.charDataID, HEAP_ID_REGISTER_HALL_OF_FAME, &sp20[0], hofMon->frontspriteCharbuf[0], hofMon->personality, TRUE, 2, hofMon->species);
2019 sub_02014510((NarcId)sp40.narcID, sp40.charDataID, HEAP_ID_REGISTER_HALL_OF_FAME, &sp20[1], hofMon->frontspriteCharbuf[1], hofMon->personality, TRUE, 2, hofMon->species);
2020 GetPokemonSpriteCharAndPlttNarcIds(&sp40, pokemon, MON_PIC_FACING_BACK);
2021 sub_02014510((NarcId)sp40.narcID, sp40.charDataID, HEAP_ID_REGISTER_HALL_OF_FAME, &sp20[0], hofMon->backspriteCharbuf[0], hofMon->personality, TRUE, 0, hofMon->species);
2022 sub_02014510((NarcId)sp40.narcID, sp40.charDataID, HEAP_ID_REGISTER_HALL_OF_FAME, &sp20[1], hofMon->backspriteCharbuf[1], hofMon->personality, TRUE, 0, hofMon->species);
2023 NARC_ReadPokepicAnimScript(narc, hofMon->frontspriteAnim, hofMon->species, 1);
2024 NARC_ReadPokepicAnimScript(narc, hofMon->backspriteAnim, hofMon->species, 0);
2025 ++data->numMons;
2026 }
2027 ReleaseMonLock(pokemon, encry);
2028 }
2029 NARC_Delete(narc);
2030}

2032static RegisterHallOfFame_MetLocationType RegisterHallOfFame_GetMetLocationType(RegisterHallOfFameData *data, Pokemon *pokemon, PlayerProfile *profile) {
2033 BOOL encry = AcquireMonLock(pokemon);
2034 RegisterHallOfFame_MetLocationType ret;
2035 int version = GetMonData(pokemon, MON_DATA_MET_GAME, NULL);
2036 if (version == VERSION_SAPPHIRE || version == VERSION_RUBY || version == VERSION_EMERALD) {
2037 ret = REGHOF_METLOC_HOENN;
2038 } else if (version == VERSION_FIRERED || version == VERSION_LEAFGREEN) {
2039 ret = REGHOF_METLOC_KANTO;
2040 } else if (version == VERSION_GAMECUBE) {
2041 ret = REGHOF_METLOC_ORRE;
2042 } else if (version == VERSION_DIAMOND || version == VERSION_PEARL || version == VERSION_PLATINUM) {
2043 ret = REGHOF_METLOC_SINNOH;
2044 } else if (GetMonData(pokemon, MON_DATA_FATEFUL_ENCOUNTER, NULL)) {
2045 ret = REGHOF_METLOC_FATEFUL;
2046 } else if (MonIsInGameTradePoke(pokemon, NPC_TRADE_SHUCKIE_SHUCKLE) == TRUE) {
2047 ret = REGHOF_METLOC_SHUCKIE;
2048 } else if (MonIsInGameTradePoke(pokemon, NPC_TRADE_KENYA_SPEAROW) == TRUE) {
2049 ret = REGHOF_METLOC_KENYA;
2050 } else if (PlayerProfile_GetTrainerID(profile) != GetMonData(pokemon, MON_DATA_OT_ID, NULL)) {
2051 ret = REGHOF_METLOC_TRADED;
2052 } else {
2053 PlayerName_FlatToString(profile, data->strbuf1);
2054 GetMonData(pokemon, MON_DATA_OT_NAME_STRING, data->strbuf2);
2055 if (String_Compare(data->strbuf1, data->strbuf2)) {
2056 ret = REGHOF_METLOC_TRADED;
2057 } else if (GetMonData(pokemon, MON_DATA_MET_LOCATION, NULL) >= METLOC_DAY_CARE_COUPLE) {
2058 ret = REGHOF_METLOC_FATEFUL;
2059 } else if (GetMonData(pokemon, MON_DATA_EGG_MONTH, NULL) == 0) {
2060 ret = REGHOF_METLOC_CAUGHT;
2061 } else {
2062 ret = REGHOF_METLOC_HATCHED;
2063 }
2064 }
2065 ReleaseMonLock(pokemon, encry);
2066 return ret;
2067}

2069static int RegisterHallOfFame_GetMmodelBySpeciesFormGender(int species, u8 form, u8 gender) {
2070 int ret;
2071
2072 if (species <= 0 || species > SPECIES_ARCEUS) {
2073 ret = NARC_mmodel_mmodel_00000001_NSBTX;
2074 } else {
2075 ret = SpeciesToOverworldModelIndexOffset(species) + NARC_mmodel_mmodel_00000297_NSBTX;
2076 if (OverworldModelLookupHasFemaleForm(species)) {
2077 if (gender == MON_FEMALE) {
2078 ++ret;
2079 }
2080 } else {
2081 if (form > OverworldModelLookupFormCount(species)) {
2082 form = 0;
2083 }
2084 ret += form;
2085 }
2086 }
2087 return ret;
2088}

2090static void RegisterHallOfFame_CreateTask_IndivMonAnimAndCry(RegisterHallOfFameData *data, int monIdx, int picIdx, BOOL startCry, int facing) {
2091 RegisterHofTaskData_IndivMonAnimAndCry *taskData = Heap_Alloc(HEAP_ID_REGISTER_HALL_OF_FAME, sizeof(RegisterHofTaskData_IndivMonAnimAndCry));
2092 taskData->hofMon = &data->mons[monIdx];
2093 taskData->startCry = startCry;
2094 taskData->narc = data->narcA180;
2095 taskData->imageLocation = NNS_G2dGetImageLocation(Sprite_GetImageProxy(data->monPics[picIdx]->sprite), NNS_G2D_VRAM_TYPE_2DMAIN);

2129static void RegisterHallOfFame_BlendAlphaFadeStep(RegisterHallOfFameData *data, u16 duration, u16 pos) {
2130 if (duration == pos) {
2131 G2_SetBlendAlpha(0, 28, 0, 0);
2132 } else {

2138static BOOL RegisterHallOfFame_WholeMonsSceneSubproc(RegisterHallOfFameData *data) {
2139 if (data->scrollingPolkadotBackground == TRUE) {
2140 ScheduleSetBgPosText(data->bgConfig, GF_BG_LYR_MAIN_2, BG_POS_OP_SUB_X, 2);
2141 }
2142 if (data->generatingConfetti == TRUE) {
2143 if (data->generateConfettiDelayTimer == data->generateConfettiDelayLength) {
2144 s16 x = LCRandom() % 224 + 16;
2145 s16 y = LCRandom() % 64 + 16;
2146 ManagedSprite_SetPositionXY(data->monPics[REGHOF_PIC_WHOLE_TWINKLE], x, y);
2147 RegisterHallOfFame_StartPicAnimSeq(data, REGHOF_PIC_WHOLE_TWINKLE, 0);
2148 data->generateConfettiDelayLength = LCRandom() % 255 + 28;
2149 data->generateConfettiDelayTimer = 0;
2150 } else {
2151 ++data->generateConfettiDelayTimer;
2152 }
2153 }
2154
2155 switch (data->subprocStage) {
2156 case REGHOF_WHOLE_SUBPROC_INITIAL_DELAY:
2157 if (data->subprocTimer == 20) {
2158 data->subprocTimer = 0;
2159 ++data->subprocStage;
2160 } else {
2161 ++data->subprocTimer;
2162 }
2163 break;
2164 case REGHOF_WHOLE_SUBPROC_FLY_IN_MONS:
2165 RegisterHallOfFame_MonSpritePosScaleAnimStep(data->monPics[data->curMonIndex], &sPicPosScaleAnimParams[data->curMonIndex], 6, data->subprocTimer);
2166 if (data->subprocTimer == 6) {
2167 ManagedSprite_SetAffineOverwriteMode(data->monPics[data->curMonIndex], 1);
2168 ++data->curMonIndex;
2169 data->subprocTimer = 0;
2170 if (data->curMonIndex == PARTY_SIZE) {
2171 data->curMonIndex = 0;
2172 ++data->subprocStage;
2173 }
2174 } else {
2175 ++data->subprocTimer;
2176 }
2177 break;
2178 case REGHOF_WHOLE_SUBPROC_DELAY_AFTER_FLY_IN:
2179 if (data->subprocTimer == 32) {
2180 data->subprocTimer = 0;
2181 ++data->subprocStage;
2182 } else {
2183 ++data->subprocTimer;
2184 }
2185 break;
2186 case REGHOF_WHOLE_SUBPROC_REQUEST_FIRST_PHOTO_FLASH:
2187 data->fadeDuration = 40;
2188 data->requestPlayFlashKanseiSfx = TRUE;
2189 data->requestBeginSpotlightsAndConfetti = TRUE;
2190 data->scrollingPolkadotBackground = TRUE;
2191 data->generatingConfetti = TRUE;
2192 ManagedSprite_SetDrawFlag(data->monPics[REGHOF_PIC_WHOLE_TWINKLE], TRUE);
2193 ++data->subprocStage;
2194 break;
2195 case REGHOF_WHOLE_SUBPROC_ANIMATE_MONS_SHADOWS:
2196 RegisterHallOfFame_BlendAlphaFadeStep(data, 80, data->subprocTimer);
2197 for (int i = 0; i < data->numMons; ++i) {
2198 RegisterHallOfFame_MonSpritePosScaleAnimStep(data->monPics[REGHOF_PIC_WHOLE_MON_SHADOW + i], &(sPicPosScaleAnimParams + 6)[i], 80, data->subprocTimer);
2199 }
2200 RegisterHallOfFame_MonSpritePosScaleAnimStep(data->monPics[REGHOF_PIC_WHOLE_PLAYER_SHADOW], &sPicPosScaleAnimParams[12], 80, data->subprocTimer);
2201 if (data->subprocTimer == 80) {
2202 data->subprocTimer = 0;
2203 ++data->subprocStage;
2204 } else {
2205 ++data->subprocTimer;
2206 }
2207 break;
2208 case REGHOF_WHOLE_SUBPROC_WAIT_BUTTON:
2209 if (IsPaletteFadeFinished() == TRUE) {
2210 if ((gSystem.newKeys & (PAD_BUTTON_A | PAD_BUTTON_B)) || System_GetTouchNew() == TRUE) {
2211 data->fadeDuration = 15;
2212 data->requestPlayFlashKanseiSfx = TRUE;
2213 ++data->subprocStage;
2214 }
2215 }
2216 break;
2217 case REGHOF_WHOLE_SUBPROC_SECOND_PHOTO_FLASH:
2218 RegisterHallOfFame_BlendAlphaFadeStep(data, 60, data->subprocTimer);
2219 if (data->subprocTimer == 30) {
2220 if (IsPaletteFadeFinished() == TRUE) {
2221 data->fadeDuration = 15;
2222 data->unk_13060_4 = TRUE;
2223 ++data->subprocStage;
2224 }
2225 } else {
2226 ++data->subprocTimer;
2227 }
2228 // fallthrough
2229 case REGHOF_WHOLE_SUBPROC_WAIT_FINAL_FADEOUT:
2230 for (int i = 0; i < data->numMons; ++i) {
2231 RegisterHallOfFame_MonSpritePosScaleAnimStep(data->monPics[REGHOF_PIC_WHOLE_MON + i], &(sPicPosScaleAnimParams + 13)[i], 60, data->subprocTimer);
2232 RegisterHallOfFame_MonSpritePosScaleAnimStep(data->monPics[REGHOF_PIC_WHOLE_MON_SHADOW + i], &(sPicPosScaleAnimParams + 20)[i], 60, data->subprocTimer);
2233 }
2234 RegisterHallOfFame_MonSpritePosScaleAnimStep(data->monPics[REGHOF_PIC_WHOLE_PLAYER], &sPicPosScaleAnimParams[19], 60, data->subprocTimer);
2235 RegisterHallOfFame_MonSpritePosScaleAnimStep(data->monPics[REGHOF_PIC_WHOLE_PLAYER_SHADOW], &sPicPosScaleAnimParams[26], 60, data->subprocTimer);
2236 if (data->subprocStage == REGHOF_WHOLE_SUBPROC_WAIT_FINAL_FADEOUT) {
2237 if (data->subprocTimer == 60) {
2238 if (IsPaletteFadeFinished() == TRUE) {
2239 data->subprocTimer = 0;
2240 data->subprocStage = 0;
2241 return FALSE;
2242 }
2243 } else {
2244 ++data->subprocTimer;
2245 }
2246 }
2247 break;
2248 }
2249
2250 return TRUE;
2251}

2490 RegisterHofSpotlightTaskData *spotlight = (RegisterHofSpotlightTaskData *)taskData;
2491
2492 if (sSpotlightsActive) {
2493 G3_BeginMakeDL(&spotlight->gxDlInfo, spotlight->gxCommand, sizeof(spotlight->gxCommand));
2494 G3B_MaterialColorDiffAmb(&spotlight->gxDlInfo, RGB_WHITE, RGB(16, 16, 16), FALSE);
2495 G3B_MaterialColorSpecEmi(&spotlight->gxDlInfo, RGB(16, 16, 16), RGB_BLACK, FALSE);
2496 } else {
2497 --sNumSpotlightTasks;
2498 SysTask_Destroy(task);
2499 }
2500}

2504
2505 if (sSpotlightsActive) {
2506 spotlight->gxCommandLength = G3_EndMakeDL(&spotlight->gxDlInfo);
2507 DC_FlushRange(spotlight->gxCommand, spotlight->gxCommandLength);
2508 } else {
2509 --sNumSpotlightTasks;

2514static void RegisterHallOfFame_AddSpotlight(SysTask *task, int xOffset, fx32 angle) {

2517 spotlight->childTasks[spotlight->numSpotlights] = RegisterHallOfFame_CreateSpotlightTaskEx(spotlight, xOffset, angle, spotlight->numSpotlights);
2518 ++sNumSpotlightTasks;
2519 ++spotlight->numSpotlights;
2520 }

2523static SysTask *RegisterHallOfFame_CreateSpotlightTaskEx(RegisterHofSpotlightTaskData *spotlight, int xOffset, fx32 angle, int index) {
2524 RegisterHofSpotlightChildTaskData *child = Heap_Alloc(HEAP_ID_REGISTER_HALL_OF_FAME, sizeof(RegisterHofSpotlightChildTaskData));
2525 child->parent = spotlight;
2526 child->xOffset = xOffset;
2527 child->color = sSpotlightColors[index];
2528 child->unused_804 = 0;
2529 child->angle = angle;
2530 child->speed = 2 * sSpotlightSpeeds[index]; // UB warning: can index past end of array
2531 child->polygonId = index;
2532 SetVec(child->vertices[0], xOffset - 80, FX16_CONST(-1), 0);
2533 SetVec(child->vertices[1], xOffset + 80, FX16_CONST(-1), 0);
2534 return SysTask_CreateOnVBlankQueue(Task_RegisterHallOfFame_SpotlightInstance, child, 2);
2535}
2536
2537static void Task_RegisterHallOfFame_SpotlightInstance(SysTask *task, void *taskData) {
2538 RegisterHofSpotlightChildTaskData *child = (RegisterHofSpotlightChildTaskData *)taskData;
2539
2540 if (sSpotlightsActive) {
2541 child->angle += child->speed;
2542 if (child->speed > 0) {
2543 if (child->angle >= FX32_CONST(170)) {
2544 child->speed *= -1;
2545 }
2546 } else {
2547 if (child->angle <= FX32_CONST(10)) {
2548 child->speed *= -1;
2549 }
2550 }
2551
2552 s32 r6 = child->angle >> FX32_SHIFT;
2553 fx32 cosVal = child->xOffset + FX_Mul(GF_CosDegNoWrap(r6), FX32_CONST(2.5));
2554 fx32 sinVal = -FX32_ONE + FX_Mul(GF_SinDegNoWrap(r6), FX32_CONST(2.5));
2555
2556 SetVec(child->vertices[2], cosVal - FX32_CONST(0.140625), sinVal, 0);
2557 SetVec(child->vertices[3], cosVal + FX32_CONST(0.140625), sinVal, 0);
2558
2559 G3B_PolygonAttr(&child->parent->gxDlInfo, GX_LIGHTID_0, GX_POLYGONMODE_MODULATE, GX_CULL_BACK, child->polygonId, 0x10, 0);
2560 G3B_Begin(&child->parent->gxDlInfo, GX_BEGIN_QUADS);
2561 G3B_Color(&child->parent->gxDlInfo, child->color);
2562 G3B_Vtx(&child->parent->gxDlInfo, child->vertices[0].x, child->vertices[0].y, child->vertices[0].z);
2563 G3B_Vtx(&child->parent->gxDlInfo, child->vertices[1].x, child->vertices[1].y, child->vertices[1].z);
2564 G3B_Vtx(&child->parent->gxDlInfo, child->vertices[3].x, child->vertices[3].y, child->vertices[3].z);
2565 G3B_Vtx(&child->parent->gxDlInfo, child->vertices[2].x, child->vertices[2].y, child->vertices[2].z);
2566 G3B_End(&child->parent->gxDlInfo);
2567 } else {
2568 --sNumSpotlightTasks;
2569 SysTask_Destroy(task);
2570 }
2571}

2599static SysTask *RegisterHallOfFame_CreateConfettiTask(RegisterHallOfFameData *data) {
2600 RegisterHofConfettiEmitterTaskData *confetti = Heap_Alloc(HEAP_ID_REGISTER_HALL_OF_FAME, sizeof(RegisterHofConfettiEmitterTaskData));
2601 int i;
2602 int j;
2603 u32 rand;
2604 u32 particleId;
2605
2606 rand = LCRandom();
2607 SetLCRNGSeed(13716);
2608
2609 for (i = 0, particleId = 0; i < 48; ++i) {
2610 confetti->particles[i].color = sConfettiColors[particleId];
2611 ++particleId;
2612 if (particleId >= 8) {
2613 particleId = 0;
2614 }
2615 fx16 sp8 = (LCRandom() % FX32_CONST(2)) - FX32_ONE;
2616 fx16 sp4 = (LCRandom() % FX32_CONST(2)) + FX32_ONE;
2617 fx16 sp0 = (LCRandom() % FX32_CONST(0.16015625)) - FX32_CONST(0.080078125);
2618
2619 for (j = 0; j < 4; ++j) {
2620 SetVec(confetti->particles[i].unk_08[j], sp8 + sConfettiCoords[j].x, sp4 + sConfettiCoords[j].y, sp0 + sConfettiCoords[j].z);
2621 SetVec(confetti->particles[i].unk_20, 0, 0, 0);
2622 SetVec(confetti->particles[i].unk_26, (LCRandom() % FX32_CONST(0.125)) + FX32_CONST(0.125), (LCRandom() % FX32_CONST(0.125)) + FX32_CONST(0.125), (LCRandom() % FX32_CONST(0.125)) + FX32_CONST(0.125));
2623 MTX_Identity44(&confetti->particles[i].translationMat);
2624 }
2625
2626 j = LCRandom() & 7;
2627 while (j--) {
2628 VEC_Fx16Add(&confetti->particles[i].unk_20, &confetti->particles[i].unk_26, &confetti->particles[i].unk_20);
2629 }
2630 }
2631
2632 SetLCRNGSeed(rand);
2633 confetti->active = FALSE;
2634 confetti->requestPushGxCommand = FALSE;
2635 confetti->unk_8D20 = FALSE;
2636 G3_MtxMode(GX_MTXMODE_POSITION_VECTOR);
2637 return SysTask_CreateOnMainQueue(Task_RegisterHallOfFame_Confetti, confetti, 0);
2638}

2641 if (task != NULL) {
2642 Heap_Free(SysTask_GetData(task));
2643 SysTask_Destroy(task);
2644 }
2645}

2650 confetti->active = TRUE;

2654static void Task_RegisterHallOfFame_Confetti(SysTask *task, void *taskData) {
2655 MtxFx44 rotMatrix;
2656 VecFx16 lightVector;
2657 RegisterHofConfettiEmitterTaskData *confetti = (RegisterHofConfettiEmitterTaskData *)taskData;
2658 if (confetti->active) {
2659 G3_BeginMakeDL(&confetti->gxDlInfo, confetti->gxCommand, sizeof(confetti->gxCommand));
2660 G3B_PolygonAttr(&confetti->gxDlInfo, GX_LIGHTID_3, GX_POLYGONMODE_MODULATE, GX_CULL_NONE, 0x3F, 0x1F, 0);
2661 G3B_MaterialColorDiffAmb(&confetti->gxDlInfo, RGB(20, 20, 20), RGB_BLACK, FALSE);
2662 for (int i = 0; i < 48; ++i) {
2663 confetti->particles[i].unk_08[3].y -= 85;
2664 if (confetti->particles[i].unk_08[3].y <= -FX16_ONE) {
2665 confetti->particles[i].unk_08[3].y = confetti->particles[i].unk_08[3].y + 2 * FX16_ONE;
2666 }
2667 confetti->particles[i].unk_08[0].y = confetti->particles[i].unk_08[3].y - FX16_CONST(0.1);
2668 confetti->particles[i].unk_08[1].y = confetti->particles[i].unk_08[0].y;
2669 confetti->particles[i].unk_08[2].y = confetti->particles[i].unk_08[3].y;
2670 VEC_Fx16Add(&confetti->particles[i].unk_20, &confetti->particles[i].unk_26, &confetti->particles[i].unk_20);
2671 MTX_Identity44(&confetti->particles[i].translationMat);
2672 MTX_TransApply44(&confetti->particles[i].translationMat, &confetti->particles[i].translationMat, confetti->particles[i].unk_08[0].x, confetti->particles[i].unk_08[0].y, confetti->particles[i].unk_08[0].z);
2673 G3B_LightColor(&confetti->gxDlInfo, GX_LIGHTID_0, RGB(11, 11, 11));
2674 G3B_LightColor(&confetti->gxDlInfo, GX_LIGHTID_1, confetti->particles[i].color);
2675 SetVec(lightVector, 0, FX16_ONE - 1, -FX16_ONE + 1);
2676 VEC_Fx16Normalize(&lightVector, &lightVector);
2677 G3B_LightVector(&confetti->gxDlInfo, GX_LIGHTID_0, lightVector.x, lightVector.y, lightVector.z);
2678 SetVec(lightVector, 0, -FX16_ONE + 1, FX16_ONE - 1);
2679 VEC_Fx16Normalize(&lightVector, &lightVector);
2680 G3B_LightVector(&confetti->gxDlInfo, GX_LIGHTID_1, lightVector.x, lightVector.y, lightVector.z);
2681 MTX_RotX44(&rotMatrix, FX_SinIdx((u16)confetti->particles[i].unk_20.x), FX_CosIdx((u16)confetti->particles[i].unk_20.x));
2682 MTX_Concat44(&rotMatrix, &confetti->particles[i].translationMat, &confetti->particles[i].translationMat);
2683 MTX_RotY44(&rotMatrix, FX_SinIdx((u16)confetti->particles[i].unk_20.y), FX_CosIdx((u16)confetti->particles[i].unk_20.y));
2684 MTX_Concat44(&rotMatrix, &confetti->particles[i].translationMat, &confetti->particles[i].translationMat);
2685 MTX_RotZ44(&rotMatrix, FX_SinIdx((u16)confetti->particles[i].unk_20.z), FX_CosIdx((u16)confetti->particles[i].unk_20.z));
2686 MTX_Concat44(&rotMatrix, &confetti->particles[i].translationMat, &confetti->particles[i].translationMat);
2687 G3B_MaterialColorSpecEmi(&confetti->gxDlInfo, RGB_WHITE, confetti->particles[i].color, FALSE);
2688 G3B_PushMtx(&confetti->gxDlInfo);
2689 G3B_LoadMtx44(&confetti->gxDlInfo, &confetti->particles[i].translationMat);
2690 G3B_Begin(&confetti->gxDlInfo, GX_BEGIN_QUADS);
2691 G3B_Normal(&confetti->gxDlInfo, 0, 0, -FX16_ONE + 1);
2692 G3B_Vtx(&confetti->gxDlInfo, -FX16_CONST(0.038), -FX16_CONST(0.05), 0);
2693 G3B_Vtx(&confetti->gxDlInfo, FX16_CONST(0.038), -FX16_CONST(0.05), 0);
2694 G3B_Vtx(&confetti->gxDlInfo, FX16_CONST(0.038), FX16_CONST(0.05), 0);
2695 G3B_Vtx(&confetti->gxDlInfo, -FX16_CONST(0.038), FX16_CONST(0.05), 0);
2696 G3B_End(&confetti->gxDlInfo);
2697 G3B_PopMtx(&confetti->gxDlInfo, 1);
2698 }
2699 confetti->gxCommandLength = G3_EndMakeDL(&confetti->gxDlInfo);
2700 DC_FlushRange(confetti->gxCommand, confetti->gxCommandLength);
2701 GF_ASSERT(confetti->gxCommandLength < sizeof(confetti->gxCommand));
2702 confetti->requestPushGxCommand = TRUE;
2703 }
2704}
2705
2706static void RegisterHallOfFame_ConfettiTask_G3Commit(SysTask *task) {
2707 if (task != NULL) {
2708 RegisterHofConfettiEmitterTaskData *confetti = (RegisterHofConfettiEmitterTaskData *)SysTask_GetData(task);
2709 if (confetti->requestPushGxCommand) {
2710 G3_PushMtx();
2711 MI_SendGXCommand(3, confetti->gxCommand, confetti->gxCommandLength);
2712 G3_PopMtx(1);
2713 confetti->requestPushGxCommand = FALSE;
2714 }
2715 }
